FORM 10-K For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. ACME ROBOTICS, INC.

Item 1. Business

Acme Robotics, Inc. designs and manufactures autonomous mobile robots for warehouses and hospitals. As of December 31, 2023, we had 2,040 full-time employees. Recurring revenue represented 33% of total revenue in fiscal 2023.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

We depend on a single supplier for our motor controllers. A disruption at that supplier could delay our shipments.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Total revenue was $1,285.3 million in fiscal 2023, an increase of 26% from $1,021.7 million in fiscal 2022. Net income was $77.0 million. Our backlog was $298.0 million at December 31, 2023.
